items.name: Vocalizer Pro
items.description: Sovereign Real-Time Vocal Processing Suite reverse-engineered from VST3. Features dynamic pitch tracking & autotune, 4-voice polyphonic harmonizer, 6-band parametric EQ, noise gate, de-esser, compressor, saturation, chorus/modulation, ducking delay, and studio reverb with interactive SVG 706x532 UI.

items.name: Kamidi Mastering Console Pro
items.description: Professional 32-bit float audio mastering console with Parametric EQ, Multiband Compressor, Brickwall Limiter, Transient Shaper, Sub Bass 808 saturation, and Dual-Pass EBU R128 LUFS metering.
items.author: Azam
